run_gumbel_sample: run gumbel sampling on logits tensor with temperature, seed, and position tensors to produce sampled token ids
apply_temperature: apply temperature scaling to a logits tensor using expanded index mapping and per-request temperature values
generate_gumbel_noise: generate gumbel noise from logits by applying temperature, random seeds, and double-log transform for sampling
find_block_argmax: find the block-wise argmax of temperature-scaled logits with gumbel noise for distributed token selection
create_fp64_random: create a true fp64 uniform random value from 64 random bits for high-precision gumbel noise generation
